Context: 11. Guidelines for Reviewing.-

12. Custody and handling of APARs.APARs to be in the custody of the designated officers. To ensure safe custody, a Register to be maintained to show the APARs files on hand, their movements, etc. Proper handing over/ taking over to be ensured when the officer concerned is transferred, etc. (Not only contents of APARs but their movements also to be kept confidential.)
